named-query.name: LoginToken.findExpired
named-query.query: SELECT l FROM LoginToken l WHERE l.expiration >= :now

named-query.name: LoginToken.findByTokenHash
named-query.query: SELECT l FROM LoginToken l WHERE l.tokenHash = :tokenHash

named-query.name: Account.findAccount
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Account a WHERE a.username = :email

named-query.name: Account.findByTokenHashAndType
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Account a, LoginToken l WHERE l.tokenHash = :tokenHash AND l.type = :type AND l.account = a
